SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_period = 4 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC 
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) as count_2025, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as distinct_stores_2025 
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) as count_2024, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as distinct_stores_2024 
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024;

SELECT 
  CASE WHEN s24.store_id IS NOT NULL AND s25.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Both'
       WHEN s24.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN '2024 only'
       ELSE '2025 only'
  END as presence,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 s24
FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 s25 ON s24.store_id = s25.store_id
GROUP BY presence
ORDER BY presence;

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(r.net_sales) as total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 lfl ON r.store_id = lfl.store_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year;

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.close_date,
  p4_fy26.has_sales_fy26,
  p4_fy27.has_sales_fy27
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.store_id, 1 as has_sales_fy26
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
) p4_fy26 ON s.store_id = p4_fy26.store_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.store_id, 1 as has_sales_fy27
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
) p4_fy27 ON s.store_id = p4_fy27.store_id
WHERE s.is_current = true
  AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025)
  AND (p4_fy26.has_sales_fy26 IS NULL OR p4_fy27.has_sales_fy27 IS NULL);

WITH sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 lfl ON r.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND r.store_id != 129
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  'Like-for-like' as lfl_type,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as prior_year_sales,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) as current_year_sales,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) /
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) * 100,
    2
  ) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM sales_by_year;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as stores_closed_between_fy25p4_and_fy27p4,
  SUM(CASE WHEN close_date IS NOT NULL AND close_date > '2025-08-24' AND close_date <= '2026-08-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as closures_in_interval
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025)
  AND close_date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) as new_stores_opened,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.store_id END) as new_stores_with_sales_in_fy27p4
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.store_id
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
) r ON s.store_id = r.store_id
WHERE s.is_current = true
  AND s.open_date > '2025-08-24'
  AND s.open_date <= '2026-08-30'
  AND s.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025);

WITH lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 lfl ON r.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND r.store_id != 129
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  'Period 4' as period,
  'FY2025/26' as prior_fiscal_year,
  'FY2026/27' as current_fiscal_year,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) /
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) * 100,
    2
  ) as lfl_growth_percent
FROM lfl_sales;
